canada.title: Anti-racism group calls for investigation after 3 Black OPP recruits allege discrimination
canada.summary: The Black Class Action Secretariat is calling for an investigation into how the Ontario Provincial Police hires new officers, in light of three Black OPP recruits across separate regions echoing similar patterns of alleged racial discrimination.

canada.title: Yukon Hospitals passes accreditation test
canada.summary: Yukon Hospitals says it has met a number of quality and safety criteria to stay accredited.

canada.title: 19-year-old soldier who died at CFB Wainwright remembered as a great friend
canada.summary: Hayden Lykkemark is from Langley and friends told Global News he showed an interest in joining the military at a young age. He died in the fire at CFB Wainwright.

canada.title: Judicial recount gives Vachon riding to Parti Québécois
canada.summary: A judicial recount in the riding of Vachon in the Montérégie region shows the Parti Québécois candidate Stephan Fogaing won the riding by three votes, according to CBC sources.

canada.title: Ontario soldier injured in CFB Wainwright fire honoured by Tecumseh mayor
canada.summary: A catastrophic military training exercise in Wainwright, Alta., that claimed the lives of four Canadian soldiers has hit close to home in Tecumseh, Ont., where one of the dozens of soldiers who were injured has deep family ties.

canada.title: City gives animal bylaw more teeth
canada.summary: The City of Calgary is looking to strengthen its rules for dealing with aggressive pets. If adopted, the changes will streamline hearings, increase penalties for violations, and make it easier for officials to determine the ownership of problem animals and who's responsible for them.

canada.title: N.L. nurses' union members scrap election result — months after new president voted in
canada.summary: Members of the Registered Nurses' Union of Newfoundland and Labrador are heading back to the polls. At their convention in Corner Brook, delegate nurses voted to overturn an election in July of new executive members — including the union president.

canada.title: N.W.T. gov't websites taken offline as a precaution due to global security concern
canada.summary: Users trying to access the Government of the Northwest Territories’ website were met with a notice saying the site was under maintenance Wednesday, a precautionary measure taken by the territorial government due to security concerns.

canada.title: Royal Regina Rifles colours return to Legislative Building after decades
canada.summary: The antecedent regimental colours of the Royal Regina Rifles have returned to Saskatchewan's Legislative Building after almost 50 years.

canada.title: $463M Port of Saint John project aims to boost New Brunswick exports
canada.summary: The Saint John Trade Corridor is the first project to receive funding through the federal Trade Diversification Corridors Fund.

canada.title: Chow, 15 councillors criticize Bradford’s plan to spin off Toronto Water into public utility
canada.summary: Mayoral challenger Brad Bradford has pitched creating a company like Toronto Hydro to deal with the city’s water. He says the plan will save money, Olivia Chow argues it means losing control.

canada.title: ‘Staggering in terms of scale’: Report finds more Canadians than ever rely on food banks to survive
canada.summary: Feed Nova Scotia is calling the 2026 Hunger Count report on food bank usage across Canada “an emergency signal and a call to action.”

canada.title: Some N.L. government sites taken offline due to 'global cybersecurity vulnerability'
canada.summary: The Newfoundland and Labrador provincial government says some of its websites and online services are down because of a "newly disclosed global cybersecurity vulnerability."

canada.title: Province directs Vitalité to send nurses filling ER vacancies back to primary care
canada.summary: Vitalité Health Network says it still needs help in an understaffed emergency room in northern N.B., despite the province telling it to return nurses it pulled from primary care back to their roles.

canada.title: N.S. NDP removes MLA Paul Wozney as whip after France post
canada.summary: Wozney removed his social media post which read, "Don't leave it to the courts. Learn from France. Own the streets. Shut government down. Grind the province/country to a halt and force government to abandon illegal legislation in the present. It's the **only** direct line to worker justice."

canada.title: Winnipeg-based rescue techs parachuted into Wainwright after deadly military base fire
canada.summary: Nearly a dozen search and rescue personnel from Winnipeg were among those deployed to Alberta when a deadly fire engulfed a training exercise at CFB Wainwright on Saturday.

canada.title: New calf born to endangered southern resident orcas in B.C.
canada.summary: Researchers say the male calf was spotted in waters near B.C. twice this week, and is likely less than a week old.

canada.title: Winnipeg mayoral candidates clash over public safety, transit in 680 CJOB debate
canada.summary: Richard Cloutier will host three of Winnipeg's mayoral candidates, incumbent Mayor Scott Gillingham, Kevin Klein and Mike Vogiatzakis, for a debate on 680 CJOB Wednesday morning.
